answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor can meet the 18% savings mandate, but the assembly line is operating at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, making an abrupt primary-source switch risky. Verify the prior second-source success during shortage conditions and the low-cost vendor’s onboarding performance before adding it as a qualified second source through a guarded test. This preserves incumbent continuity while reducing single-source exposure and testing whether savings can be captured without increasing delivery risk.
